A contrast illustration split into two panels. Left panel: a wealthy man in fine robes standing in a busy ancient street, proudly dropping coins into a beggar's bowl while a servant blows a horn to attract a crowd. Right panel: a person quietly and privately pressing some coins into the hands of a poor person in a shadowed alleyway, with no one else watching.

A simple diagram showing the cycle of Christian giving according to Paul. At the top: "God provides seeds (resources) to the giver". An arrow points down to: "The Christian gives cheerfully and bountifully". An arrow points to: "The needs of the saints are met". An arrow points up to: "The receivers give thanks and glory to God".
